MRDIR.Subtitle: Run the scene
MRDIR.MotifsHelp: A track for a specific moment. Press the active motif to return to the scene music.
MRDIR.TokenSizeHelp: Applied as you move the bar. With a floor marked it is the foreground size; distant ones shrink by perspective.
MRDIR.Opt_cover: Keep the background full-screen when panning
MRDIR.DepthScaleHelp: These options apply to every token in the scene, not only the cast.
MRDIR.CalErr_same: The two silhouettes are at the same depth: move one toward the front and one toward the back.
MRDIR.CalErr_inverted: The front silhouette must look bigger than the back one.
MRDIR.CalErr_eye: With those measures the horizon would fall below a silhouette’s feet: check the sizes.
MRDIR.FloorErr_scale: With that measure the camera would sit at an absurd height: check the real width.
MRDIR.FloorErr_eye: The horizon would fall below the rectangle: check the corners (the sides must meet upward).
MRDIR.FloorErr_level: The two vanishing points are not at the same height: this does not look like a floor rectangle seen by a level camera. Adjust the corners.
MRDIR.FloorErr_parallel: The rectangle’s sides never meet: tilt the sides a little to give it perspective.
MRDIR.FloorErr_inverted: The two bottom points must be nearer (lower) than the two top ones.
MRDIR.FloorErr_count: The floor rectangle or its measure is missing.
MRDIR.NoFigures: This scene has no figures. Add them in the editor.
MRDIR.AlreadyPlaced: The whole cast is already in the scene.
MRDIR.HandoutsHelp: Show the document or image to all players.
MRDIR.DragHint: Right-click and drag to move the bar.
MRDIR.ActiveGM: Only the active GM can change audio and figures.
MRDIR.NoReading: This scene has no linked reading.
MRDIR.NoSound: Sound not found: check the scene settings.
MRDIR.MilestonesGM: Click a milestone to achieve it (tells the table if it is public). The eye decides whether it is revealed or stays secret.
MRDIR.PhrasePlaceholder: e.g. Footsteps sound behind the door
MRDIR.ClockHelpGM: Shift + click a segment: tell the table with a line of your own.
MRDIR.ClockPublicTip: Players can see this clock. Click to hide it.
MRDIR.ClockHiddenTip: Only the GM sees this clock. Click to show it to players.
MRDIR.ClockAnnounceOnTip: Tells the table when it advances. Click to turn off.
MRDIR.ClockAnnounceOffTip: Does not announce when it advances. Click to tell the table.
MRDIR.MsPublicTip: Revealed to the table when achieved. Click to keep it secret.
MRDIR.MsSecretTip: Secret even when achieved. Click to reveal it to the table.
MRDIR.Set.ShowBarHint: Only the GM sees it. Shortcut: Alt+B.
MRDIR.Set.BgHint: Turn it off to see only the buttons over the scene.
MRDIR.Set.FadeHint: 0 = automatic (the pack value, 3.5 s by default).
MRDIR.Set.WinScaleHint: 0 = automatic: every MR- Dirección window scales in proportion to your screen so it fits whole (the reference is a 1080p monitor). Any other value fixes that scale. If it still doesn't fit, it scrolls inside. Setting for this browser.
MRDIR.Set.EditorHint: Set up music, motifs, effects, figures, handouts and markers for each scene.
MRDIR.Tour.OfferTitle: Shall I show you the direction bar?
MRDIR.Tour.OfferText: There is a guided tutorial of a few minutes. You can repeat it from the bar mix menu or in Settings → Tours.
MRDIR.Ed.Title: MR- Dirección · Editor
MRDIR.Ed.MotifsHint: Tracks are assigned in the Global tab.
MRDIR.Ed.NoMotifs: No motifs yet: create them in Global.
MRDIR.Ed.Label: Label
MRDIR.Ed.NoBackground: This scene has no background image.
MRDIR.Ed.Res: Horizon {eye} · scale ×{k} · a person at the bottom edge is {p} % of the height
MRDIR.Ed.ResNone: Not calibrated yet: follow the steps.
MRDIR.Ed.CommonHint: Click the floor: placement point (right-click deletes it). Move the cursor over the image: the silhouette shows a person’s size at each spot.
MRDIR.Ed.PlaneEditing: Drag the 4 corners onto the floor of the raised plane (platform, balcony, step) and type its real width. Press “Done” to go back to the method.
MRDIR.Ed.PlanesNeed: Calibrate the scene with a method first.
MRDIR.Ed.PlanesTip: For platforms, balconies or stairs: a rectangle on that higher floor and its real width. Figures standing inside use its own scale.
MRDIR.Ed.AnchorsTip: Click the floor of the image: where figures appear when you put them in the scene. Right-click a point to delete it. With no points, they spread out on their own.
MRDIR.Ed.FineTip: Multiplies the size of every figure in this scene, with any method. 100 % = no change.
MRDIR.Ed.ExitHeight: Real height of the far end
MRDIR.Ed.M_none_how: Choose this for top-down maps, portraits or scenes with no visible floor.|Figures appear in a row at the bottom of the scene, at the size of the “Figures” bar.
MRDIR.Ed.M_none_for: Maps seen from above or scenes with no floor: figures keep the same size.
MRDIR.Ed.M_manual_how: Drag the horizon line to the eye height of someone standing (where the floor lines would meet).|Raise or lower the scale until the silhouette that follows the cursor has the right size.
MRDIR.Ed.M_manual_for: Full control: you move the horizon and set the scale.
MRDIR.Ed.M_ref_how: Draw a rectangle covering the object from top to bottom; its bottom edge where it touches the floor.|Type its real height (a door ≈ 2.1 m).|Place the horizon: drag the line to the eye height of someone standing, or press “Horizon at eye level” if the object faces you more or less head-on.
MRDIR.Ed.M_ref_for: When there is a door, a window or a wall of known height standing on the floor.
MRDIR.Ed.M_people_how: Drag each silhouette by its body to a spot where someone could stand: 1 far away, 2 near.|Stretch its head (the red dot) to the height a person would have there; look at doors, tables or railings.|The horizon and scale come out on their own on release; the silhouette that follows the cursor shows the result.
MRDIR.Ed.M_people_for: When nothing is rectangular but you know how big someone would look: next to a door, a railing, a table.
MRDIR.Ed.M_exit_how: Draw a rectangle over the far end of the scene, where the corridor or street ends.|Adjust its corners (teal handles) until the lines from the image corners follow floor, ceiling and walls.|Type the real height of that far end (a door ≈ 2.1 m, a tunnel ≈ 3 m): it sets the scale.|Check with the silhouette that follows the cursor.
MRDIR.Ed.M_exit_for: Scenes with a far end everything converges to: corridors, streets, tunnels, halls.
MRDIR.Ed.M_floor_how: Drag the 4 corners onto something rectangular lying on the floor: handles 1 and 2 at the back, 3 and 4 at the front.|Type how wide its bottom edge really is (a flagstone ≈ 0.5 m, a rug ≈ 2 m, a corridor ≈ 3 m).|The horizon and scale come out on their own and are saved on release. The dashed lines should rise along the floor joints.|Check with the silhouette that follows the cursor: if a person looks right at several spots, it is calibrated. If everything is a bit big or small, use the fine adjustment.
MRDIR.Ed.M_floor_for: The most accurate when the floor shows: tiles, a rug, a table, the corridor.
MRDIR.Ed.FqWidth: Real width of the bottom edge
MRDIR.Ed.FqLivePlane: Scale ×{k} on this plane · camera {hc} m above it
MRDIR.Ed.MsPublic: Reveal to the table when achieved
MRDIR.Ed.ClockAnnounce: Tell the table when it advances
MRDIR.Ed.ClockPhrases: Lines on advance, one per line and per segment (the 1st on reaching 1…). A single line is always used.
MRDIR.Ed.NoScenes: There are no scenes in this world.
MRDIR.Ed.AutoDone: Auto-configured — music {m}, reading {r}, figures {f}. Please review.
MRDIR.NoAudioHint: no audio: click to assign one
MRDIR.AudioLocked: The browser still blocks audio: click the page and try again.
MRDIR.Pick.None: There are no sounds in your playlists: use “File…”.
MRDIR.NoActors: This scene has no placeable actors: check its figures in the editor.
